Overview

Villahermosa is a city in Tabasco with a population of 584,439. Capital of Tabasco with a tropical climate, oil industry, and the fascinating La Venta park museum. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7a growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. Reported crime rates are relatively high.
